content: I can’t determine the SMILES notation without any structural information about the sample. Could you please provide any available data for the compound (e.g., molecular formula, ¹H NMR chemical shifts, multiplicities and integrations, ¹³C NMR data, IR peaks, mass‑spectrometry information, or a description of the functional groups present)? With that information I can deduce the structure and give you the correct SMILES string.
